name: Manual Override (Alpha)
author: cyschneck
description: You are the first human sent out on a manned mission to Saturn’s enigmatic moon Titan. The automatic system has failed, and it’s up to you to keep the ship on course, manage resources, and complete the mission, alone. Can you survive the seven-year journey? Explore the trials and tribulations of a long-haul human spaceflight in the scientific text-based adventure: MANUAL OVERRIDE
